Found 10 items in registries @kaui:

Showing items 1-10 of 10:

- use-async (registry:hook) - A hook that owns the async action lifecycle — loading state, success, error, and settled callbacks [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- async-button (registry:component) - A button that performs async operations with a no-layout-shift loading state [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- async-scope (registry:component) - A coordination layer for async UI — decouple what fires an action from what reacts to it. [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- confirm-action (registry:component) - A confirmation dialog that wraps an async action with loading state [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-debounce (registry:hook) - A debounce hook that returns a stable { execute, cancel } object — safe to call without wrapping in useCallback [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-controlled-state (registry:hook) - Uncontrolled/controlled state bridge — use like useState but accepts optional value and onChange props for full controlled mode support [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- combobox (registry:component) - A single-select combobox with inline search, async loading support, and full controlled/uncontrolled API [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input-group (registry:component) - Compose inputs with inline addons, buttons, and labels in a styled container [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- multi-select (registry:component) - A multi-select combobox with inline search, toggle-based selection, and full controlled/uncontrolled API [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- password-input (registry:component) - A password input with show/hide toggle and an optional strength indicator [@kaui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
